slides.lead: I got rejected ~7 times. Here's the playbook I wish I had.
It's a to-do list from the person who decides if you launch. Treat it like one.
Open the guideline number in the message. Read the whole section, not just the line they quoted.
If they flag privacy, check every privacy-related screen. Otherwise you'll be back next week.
You can message them in App Store Connect. A clear question beats a guess and another round.
Add a demo account and say where things are. "Account deletion: Settings → Delete account."
Fix, test, resubmit the same day if you can. Every round is a lesson you don't need twice.
